About EPZ Audio

EPZ Audio is a factory-direct Hi-Fi brand dedicated to creating professional In-Ear Monitors (IEMs) with advanced 3D-printing technology and acoustic precision. Unlike generic dropshippers, we design, manufacture, and tune every driver in-house to ensure audiophile-grade performance at an unbeatable value.

Why Join the EPZ Insider Squad?

  • Industry-Leading Commission: Start earning 15% commission on every sale. This is 3x higher than standard marketplace rates (like AliExpress).

  • Quarterly Gear Rewards: We value our partners. Top performers who hit quarterly targets receive our latest flagship IEMs for FREE to review and keep.

  • 30-Day Tracking Window: We offer a generous 30-day cookie duration, ensuring you get credit for every customer you refer.

  • High AOV & Conversion: From entry-level budget kings to high-end bespoke multi-driver flagships, our diverse product line converts casual listeners into loyal fans.

How to Earn

Simply share your unique referral link or custom coupon code on your YouTube channel, Head-Fi blog, Discord community, or social media. Whether you are doing a deep-dive technical review or a lifestyle showcase, we provide the high-res assets you need.

Join the revolution. Turn your passion for audio into profit.
payout_period: Monthly payments via PayPal. Minimum Threshold: $50 USD. Schedule: Net-30 basis (e.g., January commissions are paid in early March). This holding period is necessary to account for our 30-day customer return policy.

EPZ Audio Insider Program – Terms & Conditions

Welcome to the Inner Circle.

Thank you for your interest in partnering with EPZ Audio. We build high-fidelity IEMs for those who truly listen. By signing up, you agree to the following terms designed to protect both our brand integrity and your earnings.

1. Approval & Account Status

  • Vetting: We manually review all applications. We look for partners with genuine audiences in the Audiophile, Tech, or Music production space.

  • Rejection: We reserve the right to reject any application that does not meet our brand standards or appears to be a "coupon scraping" site.

2. Promotion Guidelines (CRITICAL)

  • 🚫 NO Brand Bidding (PPC Restrictions): You are STRICTLY PROHIBITED from running Google Ads, Facebook Ads, or any PPC campaigns using keywords that include our brand name (e.g., "EPZ", "EPZ Audio", "EPZ IEMs") or specific model names.

    • Why? We run our own official ads. Competing with us only drives up costs for everyone. Violators will be banned and commissions forfeited immediately.

  • Content Quality: Your content must be original. Do not copy-paste our official product descriptions blindly. We value your unique perspective and hearing experience.

3. Commissions & Payouts

  • Rate: Standard commission starts at 15%. High-performing partners may be eligible for higher tiers.

  • Self-Referrals: You cannot use your own affiliate link to purchase items for yourself.

  • Payout Threshold: Payouts are processed once your unpaid earnings reach $50 USD.

  • Schedule: Payments are made via PayPal on a Net-30 basis (30 days after the month ends) to allow for any customer returns or refunds.

4. Cookie & Tracking

  • 30-Day Window: We offer a generous 30-day cookie duration. If a user clicks your link and buys within 30 days, you get paid.

  • Last Click Wins: Attribution goes to the last affiliate link clicked before the purchase.

5. Sample Policy (Review Units)

  • Joining the program does NOT automatically guarantee free review units.

  • We offer samples to partners who have demonstrated consistent traffic or sales. If you are new, we recommend purchasing a unit with your exclusive partner discount to start creating content.


5.1 Quarterly Flagship Reward (The "EPZ Elite" Tier)

We value long-term partnerships. Affiliates who generate over $1,500 USD (or 20 qualified orders) in net sales within a single quarter (Jan-Mar, Apr-Jun, etc.) will automatically qualify for the Quarterly Gear Refresh.

  • The Reward: You will receive one (1) unit of our latest IEM model released in that quarter (or a flagship model of your choice if no new release occurred).

  • Shipping: EPZ Audio covers all shipping costs for reward units.

  • Eligibility: Metrics are reviewed on the 1st day of each new quarter.


6. Termination

  • EPZ Audio reserves the right to terminate your account at any time if you are found abusing the system, spamming, or violating the PPC restrictions mentioned in Section 2.

Go forward and amplify the sound! If you have any questions, contact us at: hello@epzaudio.com
